unsupported_title: This browser can't play the game
top_tagline:
Follow the AI's hints
and snap the same photo as the GM
top_note:
No account needed.
Play in Chrome on Android, or Chrome and Edge on a computer.
error_not_found: Room not found. Check the number.
error_rate_limited: Please wait a moment and try again.
error_failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
preparing_body: A brand-new room can take a little while to open (up to 1 minute).
share_code: Share this number so everyone can join
transfer_title: Who should be the next GM?
dissolve_confirm: Close this room? Everyone will leave.
waiting_for_gm:
Waiting for the GM
to start the game
howto_1: The GM takes a secret photo
howto_2: Use the AI hints, one every 10 seconds, to take the same photo
howto_3: The closer and faster, the more points
unsupported_body:
Scene Hunter uses a networking technology called WebTransport.
Please reopen this page in one of these browsers.
unsupported_desktop: Chrome or Edge on a computer
unsupported_ios: iPhone and iPad are not supported.
retrying_body: If the connection is slow, we'll keep retrying. Please wait.
claim_failed_body: Please leave the room and join again.
gm_turn_caution: If someone sees you taking it, they will know the answer
send_failed: The photo could not be sent. Please try again
photo_unreadable: This photo could not be read. Please choose another one
gm_turn_player_note:
Don’t look at the GM.
A new hint appears every 10 seconds.
hint_wait_body: The round starts as soon as they are ready
hint_error_body:
We tried 3 times, but the AI did not respond.
Try again, or dissolve the game.
The topic photo can be reused as is.
hint_error_note: Players will keep seeing “The AI is writing hints”
no_retake: No retakes. You can submit only once.
sent_secret: Your time stays secret until the GM has picked
sent_note: The results come when everyone has submitted or time runs out
camera_denied_body:
Camera access is not allowed.
Allow the camera from the site settings in the address bar, then try again.
camera_unavailable_body:
No camera was found, or another app is using it.
Make the camera available, then try again.
topic_photo_missing: The topic photo cannot be shown on this screen
